name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters
eligibility: Applicants worldwide, including Bangladesh, subject to each programme's criteria. Bachelor's degree or final year; graduate before the master's begins. Recognised equivalent qualifications may qualify.
funding: Scholarships may cover participation costs and contribute to travel, visa and living costs. Selection and amounts depend on the programme; funding is not guaranteed.
deadline: Programme-specific. Most applications run October–January; consult the chosen course for its exact deadline and current round.
application_route: Use the official guidance and linked course catalogue, then apply directly to the institution running the selected programme.
notes: One to two years of study. This is a programme family, not a single confirmed open scholarship call. Admission, nationality, language and funding conditions vary.

name: Clarendon Scholarships
eligibility: All nationalities; new full-time or part-time Masters/DPhil applicants; academic merit and potential.
funding: Course fees and living-expense grant during fee liability.
deadline: Relevant December or January course deadline; confirm the current entry year and exact course date.
application_route: Automatic consideration from an eligible course application submitted by its funding deadline.

name: Melbourne International Undergraduate Scholarship
eligibility: Citizens of eligible countries with GDP per capita at or below US$10,000; overseas-fee bachelor offer; no prior tertiary study except school extension studies.
funding: 20% tuition remission for students commencing from 2027; selection uses final school/foundation results.
deadline: Course-specific admission deadline; separate scholarship deadline not stated.
application_route: Automatic consideration through the course application.
